purpose: Transfer and independently validate the ownership-v2-aware cleanup controller as an inert control package while proving that no real eligibility, quarantine, deletion, model access, or numerical execution occurs.

package_layout.note: The 12 bound payload files plus this prefreeze contract are copied under their repository-relative paths.
package_layout.inventory: PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS signs every regular payload file and excludes itself.

remote_validation.negative_gate: Invoke v3 preflight with a known-absent record below the project model-cleanup run scope; require nonzero exit before any target, quarantine, output record, or project model byte changes.

acceptance_rule: Accept only a fresh extracted root whose inventory covers exactly all 13 payload files; every package hash, v3 contract validator, and six synthetic tests pass; the negative gate exits nonzero; no network, GPU process, real model access, eligibility record, quarantine, deletion, or numerical row occurs.
failure_rule: Retain any archive or extracted root with its observed hashes and failure output. Never repair or reuse a rejected extraction root; a retry requires a separately frozen successor package/root.
authorization: This stage authorizes only one limited-SFTP transfer, fresh extraction, static validation, six temporary-fixture tests, and one fail-closed negative invocation. It authorizes no real cleanup preflight, eligibility record, model scan, model quarantine, model deletion, dataset mutation, result mutation, or numerical execution.
explicitly_prohibited: extracting over an existing remote root
using scp or an unlimited transfer for the archive
reading or hashing any real model target during package validation
invoking quarantine or delete against any server model
deleting or modifying datasets, results, logs, environments, sources, manifests, evidence roots or archives
treating an inert package acceptance as cleanup eligibility
next_gate: After remote inert acceptance, record the archive hash, package inventory hash, test output, negative-gate output and zero-mutation observations in an immutable package audit. Cleanup remains blocked until all three comparison tracks complete.
